title: Jamtara police arrest 10 in two fake customer-care and SIM-supply cyber fraud cases
date_note: The420.in reports the arrests were announced on 25 November; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: district police that made the arrests, as stated by the source
summary: Police in Jharkhand's Jamtara district have arrested 10 suspected cybercriminals in two separate cases, The420.in reports. Superintendent of Police Shambhu Kumar Singh said one group impersonated customer-care staff of e-commerce, digital payment and consumer goods companies; another supplied SIM cards to cybercriminals. Investigators allege fake support numbers were placed on online search platforms and victims were led to install APK files that gave access to banking information.
plain: Police in Jamtara, India, arrested 10 suspects in two cases: fake customer-care scams that led victims to install APK files, and a group that supplied SIM cards to cybercriminals.
exec: Indian police arrested 10 suspects in fake customer-care and SIM-supply fraud cases, per The420.in.
action: Jamtara authorities, as reported by The420.in, urge people never to install APK files sent by unknown callers and note a customer-care number in search results is not necessarily genuine.
